title: feat(plugin-security): under a walled posture, raise the access upgrade report in-app in the organization OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUSKmaWjm1sW7kkQuwKewbx)_

Fixes #25413

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6367880115 (`domain:services` seat 1, #6021). The branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-mfvys8`. It names no issue, so the claim is the identity record for it. #24447 (claim 6367925751) follows on this branch after this PR merges, because its report calls the helper added here.

## What changed

Under `group` and `isolated`, the boot access upgrade report reached the operator only as one `error` line in the server log (option A, ruling 6353787407). The maintainer chose to configure the owner's organization the way the owner's email is configured.

- **`@objectstack/types`:** `PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION_ENV` (`OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION`) and `resolvePlatformOwnerOrganization()`, beside the `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` pair. They use the same trim and blank rule.
- **`plugin-security`, new `upgrade-report-delivery.ts`:** the delivery of a boot upgrade report, moved out of `access-upgrade-report.ts` so #24447 can call it (Wanted 6).
  - **`single`:** unchanged and byte-identical. The notification is stamped with the Default Organization and goes to its `admin_full_access` holders plus the operators. The four "reached no administrator" causes are kept.
  - **Walled, setting unset:** the operator line only, worded as before (Wanted 5).
  - **Walled, setting set:** the value is resolved in `sys_organization` by id, then by slug. The same `security.access_upgrade` notification is emitted, with the same `dedupKey`, stamped with that organization and addressed to the configured operators. The operator line stays beside it and says a copy went in-app (Wanted 2).
  - **Set, naming no organization:** one `error` naming the value and the fix, then the operator line. Nothing is raised in-app and there is no fallback (Wanted 3). An unreadable `sys_organization`, a missing messaging service, no configured operator, or a refused emit each get the same shape with their own cause.
  - **Visibility warnings (Wanted 3 and 4):**
    - A configured operator who is not a verified member of that organization gets a `warn`, with a state of `no-account`, `unverified` or `not-member`.
    - An administrator of it who is not a configured operator gets a `warn`. An administrator here is an `owner`/`admin` membership grade, or an `admin_full_access` / `organization_admin` / `organization_admin_no_bypass` grant scoped to it.
    - The check costs two `find`s (`sys_member` and grants, by organization) plus the platform-admin standing read the bootstrap already uses.
    - A read failure gets one `warn`, and the copy still goes.
- **`access-upgrade-report.ts`:** `reportAccessUpgrade` hands its finding set to the helper. The comparison, the per-category log lines and the payload are unchanged. `AccessUpgradeNotifier` and `AccessUpgradeReportLogger` stay exported as aliases, so `security-plugin.ts` is not touched (the #25223 split series edits it).
- **`auto-org-admin-grant.ts`:** `isAdminRole` is exported. It is the existing owner/admin grade test, reused by the warning instead of copied.
- **Docs:** a row in `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` beside `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`. It says the organization must hold the operators only, and why.

Not touched: `security-plugin.ts`, `packages/core`, `packages/spec`, service-messaging, the ADR.

## Tests

- **`upgrade-report-delivery.test.ts` (new, 17 cases), each with a CONTROL:**
  - resolved by id, by slug, and with stray spaces
  - unset (the exact unchanged line) and blank
  - an unknown value, with its CONTROL once the organization exists
  - an unreadable `sys_organization`, no messaging, a refused emit, no operator
  - a non-member operator; no-account and unverified operators
  - an administrator by grade and by grant, with the CONTROL that a plain member and the tenant's own administrator are not flagged
  - an unreadable `sys_member`
  - `single` with the setting set and unset
- **`access-upgrade-report.wiring.test.ts`:** a real ObjectQL + SqlDriver + `SecurityPlugin`. It covers `isolated` and `group` with the setting naming the operator's dedicated organization (one emit, stamped with it, audience the operator, operator line beside it, and the same `dedupKey` on the next boot), and `isolated` with an unknown value. The existing `single` / walled / CONTROL cases pass unchanged.
- **`packages/types/src/env.test.ts`:** spelling, unset and blank, and a trimmed id or slug.

## Verification

- **Package suites:**
  - plugin-security `pnpm test`: exit 0, 215 files, 4485 passed and 45 skipped.
  - types `env.test.ts`: 58 passed.
  - `pnpm typecheck` for plugin-security (tsc, scripts and test-typecheck) and for types: exit 0.
  - eslint on the touched files: exit 0.
- **Dispatch gates:** all 100 commands `dispatch-gates --commands` derived exit 0. Two were re-run after a fix:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 in a shallow clone. After `git fetch --unshallow` it exits 0.
  - `check:where-matcher` flagged the new test double. The double now refuses a combinator, and the gate exits 0.
  - `check-governed-merges --branch`: not governed, 1,100 changed lines.
- **Ablations** (committed source, mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  1. Walled branch always takes the unset path: 16 cases go red (13 helper, 3 wiring).
  2. Membership warning off: 2 go red.
  3. Admin grade not read: 1 goes red.
  4. Slug lookup off: 4 go red (2 helper, and the isolated and group wiring cases).
- **R1:** `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info pnpm dev -- --fresh` on the showcase logs `[security] access upgrade report: every activation ledger row … matches the registry at this boot {"absent":[]}`, with no ERROR line.
- **R4:** production `os serve` of the showcase on a persistent SQLite file, under `isolated` and `group`. Rig details:
  - environment: `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=op@r4.example` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`
  - rows written directly: the operator as a verified `sys_user`, `owner` of a dedicated organization `r4-platform-ops`, a tenant organization beside it, and the customer's switch-off of `showcase_auditor` (`com.example.showcase`, `active=0`)
  - the vendor rename was a temporary source edit to `showcase_audit_reader`, with the `auditor` position binding it, reverted afterwards

  | boot | isolated | group |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | clean | nothing reported | nothing reported |
  | CONTROL (name still shipped, setting set) | nothing reported, no `sys_notification` | same |
  | rename, setting `r4-platform-ops` | re-enablement `ERROR`, then the operator line with "A copy is raised in-app …" and `organizationId: org_r4_platform`. One `sys_notification` row (`organization_id` `org_r4_platform`, dedup key `security.access_upgrade:a9b3…`), one inbox delivery and one `sys_inbox_message` row for `usr_r4_operator` in that organization. No row in any other organization, no refused write, no "reached no administrator". | same |
  | rename again | `[messaging] emit: dedupKey … already emitted; skipping`, still one row | same |
  | setting `r4-platform-opz` (unknown) | one `ERROR … "r4-platform-opz" names no organization by id or by slug … Fix: …`, then the unset-form operator line | not run |
  | setting unset | the unset-form operator line only, no line naming the setting | not run |
  | an `admin` member added to the operator's organization | `WARN … 1 administrator(s) … are not configured operators …` | not run |
  | setting pointing at the tenant organization | `WARN … 1 configured operator(s) are not verified members … state not-member` | not run |

  The only other ERROR line on every rig boot is `[auth] no_sign_in_account_at_boot`. The rig caused it by inserting `sys_user` directly, and it is present on the CONTROL boot too. The WARN lines match the CONTROL boot's.
